main_text.p: tio, peccatum, & sic pessime addit & infulse, [ Si Deus peccatorem pro merito punire vellet. ] Quid si punire nollet Deus pro merito? Ergo erit peccator & non defertus,ideoque conversus[?] at cum peccare in negotio conversionis sit ponere obicem Deo convertenti, sequetur eum converti, qui ponit obicem Deo convertenti, ideoque hominem reluctantem converti, vel declinabiliter, sequitur actualis defertio peccatum, & sic fieri potest ut quis peccet, & relistat Deo convertenti, & tamen non defertur, ideoq; convertatur, quod est absurdum & Arminæ justitiæ repugnans[?]. 3. Quod dicit Arminius obdurationem & excæcationem denunciari iis, qui Deo vocanti parere recusant, patet ex Arminii, eo loci, ad Perkinsium, reponsione, per obdurationem intelligi actum justitiæ divinæ, quo non convertitur peccator, & sic lepidè Arminius vult denunciari non conversionem ut poenam iis, qui non convertuntur. At vero Arminio non-conversio non potest esse & poena & peccatum. Hinc sequitur, ut solidTuiff. vin. dic grat. in Armin. An.issime observavit doctissimus vir Gul.Tuiffus, quoniam Deo vocanti parere est credere & relipiscere, Deum denunciare se non daturum fidem & relipiscentam iis, qui non credunt & relipiscunt, quam infulsa comminatio? si vos non credidertis, ego vobistiperk. l 1. p - fell.3. p. 145.-interminor me non daturum vobis, ut credatis.

page.notes: Left margin also has a small stray mark "γ" beside "datis" and a small stray mark beside the last line, which look like printer's or stray marks rather than text, so I left them out. Doubtful readings: "conversus[?]at" (the punctuation between the words is unclear); "Arminæ[?]" in the italic phrase (the letters are hard to make out); "solid" is continued to "issime" across the line break and I have joined it. The bracketed Latin is italic and reads "si Deus peccatorem pro merito punire vellet". The left-margin note text is set in small italic type and is only partly legible; the line-breaks of the margin note are transcribed as printed. Show-through marks at the left edge near "relistat" were not transcribed.
